basicMemory.placementConventions: sessions/ holds coding-session checkpoints (PreCompact and deliberate). decisions/ holds one Decision note per genuine choice not already recorded in the repo's docs/plans. tasks/ holds in-flight Task notes. bm-remember/ holds /bm-remember captures. Durable project knowledge belongs in the repo (docs/plans/MAIN.md, subplans, the README glossary), not here; notes link to those files by path.
